## M1 — `no_usable_result` reason + journey doc drift (D-05)

**Tier: T3** (changes the Roman result journey's terminal copy for a new server reason; no new endpoint, no polling, no Start/retry wiring). Base: `main`.

### What changes
- `src/types/importRunStatus.ts`: `RUN_REASON_CODES` = the pinned contract members (`CONTRACT_RUN_REASON_CODES`, unchanged, backend order) followed by `PENDING_RUN_REASON_CODES = ['no_usable_result']`. Backend lane S15a is adding this code: a server run with zero usable native/preserved results settles `failed`, never `partial`. The enum stays closed and needs an exact literal match. Any other unrecognised string still decodes to `'unknown'` and renders "Not recognised by this app version".
- Decoder fail-closed rule: `no_usable_result` with anything other than a **server `failed`** (for example `partial`, `complete`, `running`, or a legacy row) is a pairing the server cannot produce, so the status decodes to `'unknown'` instead of showing "partly finished" next to "nothing usable".
- Copy: `REASON_COPY.no_usable_result` covers the why, and the P2 catalog adds `result.noUsable.roman` / `result.noUsable.neutral` (nothing usable was imported, what to do next). `ImportRunStatusJourney` shows this text as its own node next to the server's title, body and reason, and never in place of them. There are no counts, no invented cause, and no retry button.
- Contract test: the pinned enum must still **equal** the fixture. The recognised list must equal fixture ++ declared pending. Each pending member must be **absent** from the fixture, so re-pinning to an artifact that carries the code fails until it is folded into the contract list.
- Doc drift D-05: `import-journey/README.md` said "Not registered, production-reachable". That is false now. The route is registered behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_EXTENSION_IMPORT` (default OFF), and a build with the flag ON reaches these views. I made the same correction in `P2_README.md` and in the stale `extensionImport.ts` header ("no mobile-readable progress endpoint").

### Not in this PR (reported separately)
- The advisory readiness row is read once when pairing is reached and again on app foreground, so it can still say "Not started yet" while the status read shows a running server run. This needs a pairing-hook change and is left to its own slice.

### Evidence (head `8ca600303a769ccd9f8d458e30ca6f7c70b6c7ed`)
- CI run 36649936285 "Typecheck, lint, test" passed at this head. Lint had 0 errors. `tsc --noEmit` passed. Jest: 333/333 suites, **4495/4495 tests** (base `main` 360fdc7: 4476; +19 new).
- No local runs are claimed. Regression-first holds by construction (on base the decoder maps `no_usable_result` → `'unknown'`) but was not observed in a run.
- Do not merge before operator review. This PR does not depend on the backend PR merging. When the backend artifact carries the code, re-pin the fixture and fold it into `CONTRACT_RUN_REASON_CODES`; the guard test forces that step.
title: fix(import): no_usable_result reason with truthful Roman copy; journey doc drift D-05 (M1)
